paper_metadata.title: Superior tensile properties and unique damage-fracture characteristics of Ti-2.5Cu α-titanium alloy at liquid-nitrogen temperature

evidence.quote: Ti-2.5Cu α-titanium alloy

Tensile behaviors and the resulting damage-fracture characteristics of Ti-2.5Cu α -titanium alloy were systematically investigated at liquid-nitrogen temperature (LT) plus room temperature (RT) for compari - son.

Dislocation slip as a dominant deformation mode is extensively activated in α -grains.
Indeed, both α -phase and Ti 2 Cu-intermetallic compound take part in plastic deformation. The initial straight plates in shape are significantly bended.
The strong stress concentration renders β t -microstructure itself deforming so that the inner typical pearlite-like lamellar structure is not maintained anymore.
The twins in the plate shape either traverse across the entire α -grain or intersect with other twins, which divides α -grain into numerous rooms in smaller dimensions
The straight α -plate and Ti 2 Cu-plate can be distinguished clearly as well.
Being different from the RT samples, the inner typical pearlite-like structure is still retained.
